summary: Frontend-only iteration validating visual refinements + color rule (gabarito). Executed on Expo web preview at 390x844 with VAGNER/vagner123. ALL 11 acceptance criteria PASS. Console shows only the previously reported non-blocking 'shadow*' RN-web deprecation warning; no errors, no red screen.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' persists (same as iteration 2). Not tied to this iteration's changes.

action_items: (LOW) Migrate remaining shadow* RN styles to boxShadow to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: logo-header.tsx: hamburger renders when onMenu is supplied (dashboard passes it), title uses adjustsFontSizeToFit + minimumFontScale 0.75 and numberOfLines 1; logoRight branch renders Byvision logo on the right and no 'Olá' text anywhere. Verified header text is exactly 'menu-icon\nPainel de Performance'.

dashboard.tsx HeroBar: computes tone from ritmo (real/prev) using thresholds >=1 success, >=0.76 warning, else error; renders horizontal heroTrack + heroFill + heroMarker; legend shows Realizado/Previsto with %; footer text 'Falta <BRL> para 100% da meta'. Matches spec.

dashboard.tsx: clientQuery filters by nome (lowercase) OR cod_cliente.includes(cq); TextInput has testID 'client-search' and clear button testID 'client-search-clear'. Verified: 'SUP' filters to 0 clients (no match in current dataset), clearing restores full list.
city-chips.tsx: chip uses backgroundColor:'transparent' + borderWidth 1.5, border color brand when active else borderStrong. Verified computed bg rgba(0,0,0,0) and active border rgb(0,170,121).
dashboard.tsx sortChip: same outline pattern; active border color equals brand.

client-row.tsx: toneColor derived from ritmo with 0.76/1.0 thresholds; badge backgroundColor and gapText color BOTH use toneColor -> visually coherent. Verified from live DOM: rows with 32%/59%/75% -> red (rgb(217,48,37)) badge AND red gap text; row with 78% -> orange (rgb(230,149,0)) badge AND orange gap text; rows with >=100% -> green (rgb(0,170,121)) both. Rule 0-75 RED / 76-99 YELLOW / >=100 GREEN confirmed exactly.
client/[cod].tsx: label 'Previsionado' (replaces 'Ideal hoje') confirmed; barColor uses same threshold rule (ritmo-based); pctBig color uses barColor.

bar-chart.tsx: bar backgroundColor uses colors.onSurface (neutral) with opacity variation, NOT success/green. Screenshot confirms bars render in neutral gray. Tap on bar-<mes> shows tooltip 'Março 2026 R$ 114,90' as verified.
